target: roadside fruit stands and farm stands Leeward and Central Oahu (Waianae, Nanakuli, Kunia, Wahiawa, Waialua)

rows.name: North Shore Farm Stand
rows.address: Hale'iwa Road at Paalaa Rd, Haleiwa, HI 96712
rows.schedule_text: Wednesdays 12pm to 6pm per the contact page; the homepage says Wednesdays and Thursdays 12pm to 6pm.
rows.description: Stand selling fresh produce and products from North Shore farmers, homesteaders and entrepreneurs. Farmers listed include Tin Roof Ranch (fruit orchard, chickens, turkeys, sheep) and Ala Mai Farmstead.
rows.notes: Home page says Wed and Thu 12-6pm; contact page lists Wednesdays only. Pages are undated (footer copyright 2024), so confirm hours with the stand. Address is Haleʻiwa but the stand serves the Waialua moku.

rows.name: ʻĀINA Farm Stand
rows.venue_name: Kōkua Learning Farm (Unit B on the highway, with Kōkua General Store)
rows.schedule_text: Tuesday to Friday 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.; Saturday opens 8:30 a.m. (Saturday closing time not stated in the source).
rows.description: Stand opened November 2024 in the property's historic flower shop. Sells produce from the Kōkua Learning Farm and other local farms plus value-added products. Proceeds go to the foundation.
rows.source_label: Community article (Oahu Travel Guide), indexed about 4 days before 2026-10-31
rows.notes: Third-party source; the organizer's own page was not retrieved. Haleʻiwa is outside the listed towns (Waiʻanae, Nanakuli, Kunia, Wahiawā, Waialua).

rows.name: Da Banana Stand (Living Circle Farms Hawaii)
rows.schedule_text: Open seasonally and by appointment only.
rows.description: Seasonal produce and natural products grown on the farm and sold at Da Banana Stand.
rows.notes: Page is undated. Appointment-only, so it may not be a walk-up roadside stand. No hours or contact method retrieved.

rows.name: Waialua Fresh Egg Farm (farm stand)
rows.description: Family-owned farm selling fresh, cage-free eggs from a roadside stand/trailer. Free parking in front of the stand. A Haleʻiwa Town guide also mentions a bee farm tour.
rows.source_label: Community guide (Haleiwa Town) plus the farm's Facebook page
rows.notes: Sells eggs, not fruit. No stand hours found. The guide was indexed about 323 days before 2026-10-31 and the Facebook page about 216 days. Confirm it is still operating.
